first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the active loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts, but the inherited evidence establishes acquisition and revenue lift rather than sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify retention, customer quality, margin, and post-promotion behavior before committing. Memory 86 is the strongest competing direction given the onboarding decline, but its evidence currently stops at early adoption.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The verified source shows higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (-2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing because its verified cohort suffered 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Longer-term revenue impact from onboarding simplification remains uncertain, so retain an experimental holdout and track qualified revenue and retention.
